contentType.description: Content type. Please see {@link ContentMeta} and {@link ContentType} for more information

contentEncoding.description:
Currently only allows gzip compression
This should only be used when the file is being written to S3

order.description:
Order expression.
Doesn't work with cassandra target types in BatchExportSpec

limit.description:
Limit the number of objects to export.
Doesn't work with cassandra target types in BatchExportSpec

csvHeader.description:
Header when exported data as csv.
Required if the content type is csv

csvFormat.description: Optional format for a csv values. Key should be path used in a csv header.

xmlInclude.description:
Include spec when exporting data as xml.
Works only with {@link Persistable#exportData} function

jsonInclude.description:
Include spec when exporting data as json.
Works only with {@link Persistable#exportData} function

content.description:
Should be a ref to an entity type mixing Content. It's contentType will determine format of the exported data.
which can either be a c3 canonical csv or c3 canonical xml.

contentName.description:
Content name if content should be created by export data api
If starts with s3://, it is exported to S3

piiFields.description:
Only used when anonymize is true.
Additional fields that you want to anonymize in addition to the fields annotated with
@PII(category="someCategory". Keys: field names, values: the anonymization category that should be applied on the
field, must be taken from AnonymizationCategory ('address', 'name', 'phone', 'dob', 'email' or 'random').

anonymize.description: True will anonymize fields marked with @PII annotation in type definition and fields in piiFields

skipFields.description: Fields to be excluded from export (e.g. meta, version etc.).

whitelistedFields.description: Whitelisted fields used in green button format export.

progressCallbackPeriod.description: Wait time in seconds between progress report callbacks. Only meaningful if progressCallback is specified.

progressCallback.description: Should be a ref to an entity type mixing {@link ExportProgress}.

title: Specification of the options/parameters for the {@link Persistable#exportData} function.
name: ExportDataSpec
